session_id.description: Globally unique ULID for this discovery session.

max_steps.description: Maximum total cycle steps before budget exhaustion.

max_llm_calls.description: Maximum LLM propose calls before budget exhaustion.

max_cost_usd.description: Cost cap in USD, or null for no cost limit.

host_allowlist.description: Allowed hosts — navigation outside this set is blocked.

rationale.description: Model's stated reasoning for this cycle — audited, never executed.

id.description: Step identifier, unique within the plan.

anyOf.description: Step-level security scope.

scope.description: Step scope; null inherits the plan default.

requires_confirmation.description: If true, the executor pauses for human consent before executing this step. Only legal on click, fill, fill_element, and navigate steps.

confirmation_description.description: Human-readable override for the consent card. Falls back to step name when null.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code or descriptive label (e.g. "USD", "credits").

anyOf.description: Best-effort cost estimate for the action being confirmed.

expected_cost.description: Best-effort cost estimate shown on the consent card, or null if unknown.

anyOf.description: How difficult it would be to undo the action if it goes wrong.

consequence.description: Reversibility hint for the action, or null to default to "unknown".

value.description: Literal scalar value embedded in the plan.

anyOf.description: Literal scalar value.

hosts.description: Trusted website hosts allowed to receive this secret. Required for browser fills.

anyOf.description: Reference to a credential stored outside the plan payload.

step_id.description: Extract step id that produced the capture.

field.description: Optional extracted field key. Null means the whole capture payload.

anyOf.description: Reference to values captured by a previous extract step.

additionalProperties.description: Any value reference that can flow through a plan or workflow.

bindings.description: Typed mapping from placeholder names to value references.

anyOf.description: Templated value with explicit typed bindings.

url.description: Target URL as a value reference.

anyOf.description: Navigate browser to a URL.

kind.description: Semantic intent locator that engine resolves.

flags.description: Regex flags such as i or im.

field_name.description: Accessible field name used for fresh resolution.

locator.description: Fallback locator chain for the target field.

value.description: Semantic value committed through the unified fill engine.

fields.description: Field mapping for extracted object rows.

else_step_id.description: Optional step id for false branch.

body_step_ids.description: Step ids that form the loop body.

max_iterations.description: Hard cap for loop iterations at runtime.

anyOf.description: Iterate over collection values.

params.description: Param values passed to called workflow.

capture_as.description: Optional capture alias for workflow output.

anyOf.description: Invoke another workflow from the current plan.
Summarize extracted captures with an LLM.

items.description: Single executable unit in a validated plan.

steps.description: 1–3 standard protocol steps to execute this cycle.

goal_met.description: Whether the agent believes the goal has been achieved.

summary_md.description: Markdown summary of what was found or accomplished.

citations_hint.description: URLs of pages actually visited that support the summary claims.

anyOf.description: Terminal claim — triggers Brief assembly when goal_met is true.

done.description: Terminal claim, or null if the goal is not yet met.

proposal.description: The (possibly normalized) proposal for this cycle.

url.description: Current page URL after cycle execution.

title.description: Page title or null if unavailable.

page_digest.description: Sanitized + truncated extract of readable page content.

name.description: Accessible name or label, truncated to 200 chars. Null if unnamed.

kind.description: Coarse interaction kind for the model to reason about.

disabled.description: Whether the element is disabled or aria-disabled.

items.description: Sanitized descriptor of one interactable element on the page.

interactables.description: Visible, enabled interactable elements (cap 30, ranked by prominence).

step_outcome.description: Typed outcome of the cycle execution.

outcome_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the outcome (e.g. ethics rule, error message). Null on clean completion.

anyOf.description: Post-sanitizer observation of the current page state, sent to the model.

observation.description: Post-cycle observation, or null if the cycle was rejected without execution.

items.description: One propose → act → observe turn in a discovery session.

promoted_workflow.description: Workflow name if the path was promoted via --save-as, or null.
